SUBJECT: Lot Line Adjustment (LLA No. 25-01)

PROJECT PROPOSAL/REQUEST
Consideration of a Lot Line Adjustment (LLA) to modify a boundary line between two existing parcels
located at 8600 Rheem Avenue, within the Industrial Flex (IF) zone, and consideration of a Categorical
Exemption under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15305 (Class 5 –
Minor Alterations in Land Use Limitations) for a minor lot line adjustment.

PROJECT OVERVIEW

•  General Plan Designation: Firestone Industrial District
•  Zoning:  Industrial Flex (IF)
•  Project Location:  8600 Rheem Avenue
•  Assessor’s Parcel Numbers: 6216-003-007 & 6216-003-005
•  Applicant:  Jim Bonham on behalf of HUSPRF Bowers LP
  (Owner of APN 6216-003-0005)
  & Randy Steinberg on behalf of New South Central Properties, LLC
  (Owner of APN 6216-003-007)

BACKGROUND

Site Characteristics:

The subject properties consist of two adjacent lots on Rheem Avenue that also adjoin the Southern Pacific
Railroad, located within the Industrial Flex (IF) zone.

Parcel A, Assessor’s Parcel Number (APN) 6216-003-007, is an irregularly shaped flag lot that measures
approximately 2.28 acres (99,316 square feet). The lot is currently developed with an industrial building
occupied by Glasswerks, a glass manufacturing facility. The lot is owned by New South Central Properties,
LLC, an affiliate of Glasswerks.

Parcel B, APN 6216-003-005, is an irregularly shaped triangular lot measuring approximately 0.23 acres,
or 10,018 square feet. The lot is currently being used for outdoor waste storage within metal roll-off
containers and freight truck parking. The lot is owned by HUSPRF Bowers LP.

Surroundings:

The site is surrounded by a mix of industrial and commercial uses, with Rheem Avenue and Mason Street
providing primary access to both lots. The Southern Pacific Railroad adjoins the northerly boundary of the

subject property. There is a large manufacturing and warehousing facility directly east of the subject site,
an impound lot/tow yard directly south, and additional glass manufacturing and warehousing facilities
directly across Rheem Avenue to the west, operated by Glasswerks.

Proposed Lot Line Adjustment: HUSPRF Bowers LP wishes to sell 6969.6 square feet (0.16 acres) of its
property to New South Central Properties, LLC, which has agreed to purchase that square footage. To
accomplish this, the applicants are requesting approval of a Lot Line Adjustment to allow the relocation of
the lot line between the two existing parcels, effectively shifting the sold square footage from HUSPRF
Bowers LP’s lot into New South Central Properties, LLC’s lot.

By modifying the lot line, Parcel A would gain 6969.6 square feet resulting in a total lot size of 105415.2
square feet (2.42 acres). Parcel B would lose 6969.6 square feet resulting in a total size of 3049.2 square
feet (0.07 acres).

ANALYSIS:
Municipal Code Requirements for Lot Line Adjustments: Pursuant to South Gate Municipal Code (SGMC)
Section 12.10.020, the LLA shall be heard by the Planning Commission at a scheduled hearing; and action
shall be taken to approve, conditionally approve, or disapprove such LLA.

ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS:
The proposed project qualifies for a Categorical Exemption under CEQA Guidelines Section 15305 (Class
5 – Minor Alterations in Land Use Limitations) which exempts from CEQA minor lot line adjustments not
resulting in the creation of any new parcel nor any changes in land use or density.

DEPARTMENT COMMENTS:
Staff routed the project for comments to several City Departments, including the Public Works Department.
No comments or conditions were provided.

RECOMMENDATION:
Based on the evidence presented, Staff recommends that the Planning Commission find that the project is
Categorically Exempt from CEQA under Section 15305, (Class 5) “Minor Alterations In Land Use
Limitations” of the CEQA Guidelines, make the required findings and requirements set forth in the South
Gate Municipal Code, and adopt a Resolution to approve Lot Line Adjustment No. 25-01 associated with
8600 Rheem Avenue, subject to the recommended conditions of approval stipulated in the proposed
Resolution and/or other conditions that the Planning Commission may wish to impose.

   RESOLUTION NO. 2025-09

A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF SOUTH GATE PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING
LOT LINE ADJUSTMENT NO. 25-01 TO ALLOW THE MODIFICATION OF A BOUNDARY
BETWEEN TWO ADJACENT PARCELS LOCATED AT 8600 RHEEM AVENUE, AND
FINDING THE PROJECT CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT FROM THE CALIFORNIA
ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT.

  WHEREAS, Jim Bonham, on behalf of HUSPRF Bowers LP, and Randy Steinberg on behalf of
New South Central Properties, LLC (the "Applicants"), filed a complete application requesting approval of
a Lot Line Adjustment (LLA) to modify a boundary line between two existing parcels (The “Project”); and

  WHEREAS, the Project site is comprised of two adjacent parcels, identified as Assessor’s Parcel
Numbers 6216-003-007 (Parcel A), which is owned by New South Central Properties, LLC, and 6216-003-
005 (Parcel B), which is owned by HUSPRF Bowers LP, and are located within the Industrial Flex (IF)
zone; and

  WHEREAS, the Project involves relocating the boundary line separating the two parcels in a
manner that will result in Parcel A gaining approximately 6,969.6 square feet (0.16 acres) for a new total
parcel size of approximately 105415.2 (2.42 acres) ; and Parcel B losing 6,969.6 square feet for a new total
parcel area measuring approximately 3049.2 square feet (0.07 acres) ; and

  WHEREAS, Pursuant to South Gate Municipal Code (SGMC) Section 12.10.020, the LLA shall
be heard by the Planning Commission at a scheduled hearing; and action shall be taken to approve,
conditionally approve, or disapprove such LLA; and

  WHEREAS, notice of the Planning Commission public hearing of October 7, 2025, was published
in compliance with State law in a local newspaper of general circulation. In addition, a public notice was
mailed 10 days in advance of the hearing to each property owner, occupants and resident within a 100-foot
radius of the project site, indicating the date and time of the public hearing in accordance with South Gate
Municipal Code Section 12.10.020; and

  WHEREAS, on October 7, 2025, the Planning Commission held a public hearing to receive public
testimony and other evidence regarding the LLA, including without limitation, information provided to the
Planning Commission by City staff and public testimony; and

  WHEREAS, the Planning Commission reviewed the Project’s environmental impacts under the
California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) and determined the Project qualifies for a Categorical
Exemption under Section 15305 (Class 5 – Minor alterations in land use limitations) of the CEQA
Guidelines; and

  WHEREAS, this Resolution and its findings are made based upon evidence presented to the
Commission at its public hearing including, without limitation, the staff report submitted by the Community
Development Department; and

  WHEREAS, all legal prerequisites to the adoption of this Resolution have been met.

NOW, THEREFORE, THE PLANNING COMMISSION DOES HEREBY FIND, DETERMINE
AND DECLARE AS FOLLOWS:

  Planning Commission Resolution No. 2025-09
  October 7, 2025

 SECTION 1.  All of the facts set forth in the recitals are true and correct and are incorporated herein by
reference.

SECTION 2. Based on substantial evidence, both written and oral, from the public hearing, the Planning
Commission finds that the approval of the LLA is consistent with the General Plan and zoning regulations
in accordance with City policies and State laws.

SECTION 3. The Planning Commission reviewed the project’s environmental impacts under the
California Environmental Quality Act (California Public Resources Code §§ 21000, et seq., “CEQA”) and
the regulations promulgated thereunder (14 California Code of Regulations §§ 15000, et seq., the “CEQA
Guidelines”) and finds the project to be exempt under a Class 5 Categorical Exemption pursuant to Section
15305 (Class 5 – minor alterations in land use limitations) of the CEQA Guidelines (Title 14, Division 6,
Chapter 3 of the California Code of Regulations); and

SECTION 4. The Planning Commission hereby approves the LLA to allow the modification of a
boundary between two existing parcels located at 8600 Rheem Avenue.

SECTION 5. The Secretary of the Planning Commission shall certify the adoption of this Resolution and
shall maintain a copy in the official records of the City.
Approved and ADOPTED this 7th of October 2025.
